# Legacy Bugs v1.2.0 — Minecraft 26.2

Legacy Bugs v1.2.0 adds an in-game configuration screen and improves multiplayer server control.

## What's New

- Added an in-game Legacy Bugs configuration screen
- Added default `-` keybind to open the configuration screen
- Added TRUE / FALSE controls for:
  - Global Legacy Bugs toggle
  - LB-001 — Grindstone Enchantment Merge Bug
  - LB-002 — MC-271398 Crafting Result Bug
- Added client/server config synchronization
- Added server-authoritative configuration updates
- Added permission checks for dedicated servers
- Operators can modify Legacy Bugs settings
- Non-operators can view settings but cannot modify them
- Added editable / view-only status display
- Added Refresh and Done controls
- Improved configuration screen layout and styling
- Updated Minecraft target to 26.2

## Included Historical Bugs

### LB-001
Grindstone Enchantment Merge Bug from snapshot 24w11a.

### LB-002
MC-271398 Crafting Result Bug from snapshot 24w18a.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API 0.157.0+26.2

## Configuration

Default keybind:

```text
-
```

Commands are also available:

```text
/legacybugs status
/legacybugs enable
/legacybugs disable
/legacybugs lb001 enable
/legacybugs lb001 disable
/legacybugs lb002 enable
/legacybugs lb002 disable
```

Configuration is saved in:

```text
config/legacy-bugs.json
```

## Multiplayer

On dedicated Fabric servers:

- Operators can modify Legacy Bugs settings
- Non-operators can view the current settings
- Non-operators cannot modify server settings
- Server-side permission checks are enforced

# Legacy Bugs v1.0.0 for Minecraft 26.2

This release supports the modern Java 25 version of Legacy Bugs for Minecraft 26.x.

## Supported Version

- Minecraft 26.1.2 to 26.2
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or later
- Fabric API for Minecraft 26.x

Do not use this JAR for Minecraft 1.21.11 or other Java 21 versions.

## Included Bugs

### LB-001 — Grindstone Enchantment Merge Bug

Restores the historical grindstone enchantment merge behavior from snapshot 24w11a.

Confirmed behavior:

- The top input item receives enchantments from the bottom input item
- The bottom input item remains unchanged
- The output slot shows a normal grindstone output without enchantments
- Mutually exclusive enchantments can be merged into the top input item
- Grindstone durability repair behavior still works normally on the output item

### LB-002 — MC-271398 Crafting Result Bug

Restores the historical crafting remainder position bug from snapshot 24w18a.

Confirmed behavior:

- Crafting remainders are applied starting from the top-left crafting grid slot
- The original recipe position inside the crafting grid is ignored
- Container items can appear in the wrong slot
- The original input item can remain in its original slot when the recipe is placed away from the top-left corner

## Tested

This release has been built and tested in Minecraft 26.2 with Java 25.

Both LB-001 and LB-002 were confirmed working in-game.

## Notes

This release is separate from the Java 21 / Minecraft 1.21.11 version.

Use the correct JAR for your Minecraft version.
